output.summary: The run is VALID with COMPLETE coverage, and the deterministic policy verdict is NO_POLICY: neither the reference (1767225600000–1767225720000 ms) nor evaluation (1767225720000–1767225960000 ms) window had a business or resource policy defined, so no PASS/FAIL determination was made (NO_POLICY is not a PASS). JMeter sampling shows 7200 samples overall with error_count 0 and overall p50/p95/p99/max latency 201/237/239/240 ms; achieved throughput is 20 requests/s in both windows and the target series is constant at 20 requests/s. One correlation candidate was selected in the evaluation window: resource-00 (ratio) vs response_time_p95_ms, rho 0.965154108981 at best_lag_ms 0, Holm-adjusted p 0.016 across 16 family hypotheses (status SELECTED/CANDIDATE). All 15 other resource pairs were BELOW_EFFECT or NOT_SELECTED. Interpretation limits: the requested target control was constant and dropped (CONSTANT_CONTROL); correlation uncertainty is NOT_ESTIMATED for every pair; clock_alignment is not_verified_by_core so no lead/lag ordering is established; anomalies_tested=0 and episodes_reported=0 in the diagnostic summary; sensitivity_without_achieved_rps is null. The high correlation is a hypothesis to test, not a proven cause.

hypotheses.observation: In the evaluation window, correlation pair-00 reports resource-00 (ratio) with response_time_p95_ms at best_lag_ms 0: raw_rho = partial_rho = 0.965154108981, status CANDIDATE, and it is the only pair selected after Holm adjustment (holm_adjusted_p_value 0.016, max_p_value 0.001, alpha 0.05, family_hypotheses 16).
hypotheses.possible_explanation: resource-00 utilization and p95 response latency rise and fall together in the evaluation window, which could indicate a shared driver such as service saturation or contention; the evidence is a stored correlation, not proof that one causes the other.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Verify clock alignment between the JMeter sampler timestamps and resource series (clock_alignment is not_verified_by_core), then plot resource-00 against the p95 latency series over the evaluation window, inspect the lag profile beyond lag 0, and confirm whether the association persists when load is varied instead of constant.

hypotheses.observation: For every correlation pair, controls_requested contains 'target' and controls_dropped contains 'target', with reason CONSTANT_CONTROL and controls_used empty; the target series is constant at 20 requests/s in both reference and evaluation windows.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: Because the target load metric was constant at 20 requests/s, it could not be used as a control, so the candidate correlation between resource-00 and p95 latency is not adjusted for load or any other unmeasured time-varying factor and may be confounded.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Re-run with non-constant load levels (e.g., step or ramp profiles) so the target control can actually be used, or add additional candidate controls, and re-estimate the correlation with uncertainty.

hypotheses.observation: Both window-policy-summary entries report business_verdict NO_POLICY, resource_verdict NO_POLICY, and verdict NO_POLICY, and the run-level policy_verdict fact is NO_POLICY.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: No business or resource policy thresholds were defined, so the analysis could not produce a PASS or FAIL decision for either window; missing policy is not a pass and the selected correlation candidate does not itself constitute a violation.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Define explicit business and resource policy thresholds (SLOs) for latency and resource utilization, then re-run the analysis so windows can receive a PASS/FAIL verdict instead of NO_POLICY.

hypotheses.observation: Reference window latency is p50 211 / p95 238 / p99 240 / max 240 ms with sample_count 2400, while evaluation window latency is p50 193 / p95 236 / p99 239 / max 239 ms with sample_count 4800; both windows achieved 20 requests/s and the target metric is constant at 20 requests/s.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: Latency levels differ slightly between the windows while achieved throughput stayed constant at 20 requests/s, so a non-load factor (for example scheduling, resource contention, or environmental noise) may explain the change rather than load alone.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Inspect the cell-level latency and resource time series across both windows, confirm timestamp alignment first, and test whether the latency distribution shift is reproducible under a controlled variable-load design.

hypotheses.observation: The diagnostic summary reports anomalies_tested 0 and episodes_reported 0, pairs_evaluable 16 and pairs_tested 16, with status COMPLETE and uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: No anomaly episodes were tested or reported in this diagnostic, so the empty anomaly result cannot be interpreted as evidence that the system is stable or free of problems; it only means no anomaly testing was performed.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Enable anomaly episode testing on the resource and latency series (or document why it was skipped) before drawing any conclusion about stability or the absence of anomalies.

recommendations.action: Verify and, if necessary, instrument clock alignment between JMeter sampler timestamps and resource-series timestamps before interpreting the pair-00 correlation or any lag ordering.
recommendations.rationale: resource-binding reports clock_alignment not_verified_by_core, and best_lag_ms is 0 with only a single lag profile entry; without verified timestamps no temporal lead/lag or causal reading is justified.

recommendations.action: Investigate the resource-00 vs p95 latency candidate (rho 0.965154108981, Holm-adjusted p 0.016): plot the series, review lag profiles beyond 0 ms, and re-run with variable load before treating it as a real bottleneck signal.
recommendations.rationale: The pair is only a CANDIDATE with NOT_ESTIMATED uncertainty, the target control was dropped as CONSTANT_CONTROL, and correlation does not imply causation.

recommendations.action: Define explicit business and resource SLO thresholds so that windows can be evaluated as PASS or FAIL rather than NO_POLICY.
recommendations.rationale: Both window-policy-summary entries and the run-level policy_verdict are NO_POLICY, which is not a pass; without thresholds the analysis cannot judge whether the observed latency/resource behavior is acceptable.

recommendations.action: Repeat the load test with non-constant achieved load (step or ramp profiles) so the target control is usable, and add uncertainty estimation to the correlation pairs.
recommendations.rationale: The constant 20 requests/s target caused the requested control to be dropped (CONSTANT_CONTROL) and all uncertainty fields are NOT_ESTIMATED, so confounders and statistical uncertainty remain unaddressed.

recommendations.action: Enable anomaly episode testing on the resource and latency series for the next run, and record the reason if it remains disabled.
recommendations.rationale: The diagnostic summary reports anomalies_tested 0 and episodes_reported 0, so the absence of reported episodes cannot be used as evidence of stability.

caveats: The deterministic verdict is NO_POLICY for both windows and at run level; this is not a PASS and no SLO thresholds were defined.
Clock alignment between JMeter samples and resource series is not_verified_by_core, so no lead/lag or temporal causal ordering is established; best_lag_ms 0 is not a verified duration relationship.
All correlation pairs report uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED and sensitivity_without_achieved_rps is null.
The target control was constant at 20 requests/s and dropped (CONSTANT_CONTROL), so the pair-00 correlation is not adjusted for load or other unmeasured time-varying factors.
error_count 0 across 7200 samples does not prove stability, spare capacity, or absence of a problem.
anomalies_tested 0 and episodes_reported 0 mean no anomaly testing was performed; the empty anomaly result is not evidence of absence of anomalies.
Only pair-00 was selected after Holm adjustment across 16 hypotheses (alpha 0.05); the other 15 pairs were BELOW_EFFECT or NOT_SELECTED, so findings are limited to resource-00.
The out-of-window run margin (run_to_epoch_ms 1767225960169 vs snapshot_to_epoch_ms 1767225960000) and aggregate throughput fields were not further validated in this advice.
